packageRules.description: Everything that may land unattended rides in one PR; CI is the gate.
An action's SHA pin is only worth something if a moved tag is read before it lands. Never automerged.
Majors are read by a human. They are where renames, dropped Node versions and changed defaults live.
Postgres majors are a dump-and-restore, not a container restart: the new image refuses to start against an old data directory. Held permanently; see docs/deployment.md.
A Node major changes the runtime under the app and the base image at once. Manual, and it must be paired with the CI node-version.

esbuild is pinned exactly on purpose. Surface the update but never merge it unread. Its own group: a group automerges only if every update in it may, so inside "all non-major" it would hold the whole group back.
Renovate cannot regenerate a lock file after bumping an npm override (npm fails with EOVERRIDE). Overrides are caret ranges, so lock file maintenance moves them within range instead.
